pg.quote: Vatu Express … depths between 15-30 m … renowned for its powerful currents

highlights.text: Soft coral wall with reef fish and pelagics

bw.quote: Golden Dreams reminds many divers of Mellow Yellow just on a shallower scale. The highlight of this dive is the current side rock face with many yellow soft coral trees and the near-by swim-though lined with the same soft corals.

highlights.text: Yellow soft coral trees on current-side rock face
Swim-through lined with yellow soft coral

pg.quote: Amazing Maze … found at depths between 15-35 m

dtw.quote: this site bottoms out at around only 20m

highlights.text: Reef fish sheltering in coral formations

summary.text: A maze of channels, swim-throughs and canyons on the outer reef by Nananu-i-Ra. Depth is modest so buoyancy control matters more than the numbers, and the coral nooks suit photography.

bw.quote: Neptunes Rhapsody is a series of coral bommies with schools of Anthias living within soft corals

dwr.quote: Neptune's Rhapsody is a collection of coral bommies hiding swim throughs and white tip reef sharks

summary.text: A cluster of soft-coral-topped bommies near Rakiraki with swim-throughs along their bases. Anthias swarm over the tops and whitetip reef sharks and nudibranchs turn up around the formations.

sites.name: Breath Taker

dtw.quote: Breathtaker . 3 coral heads sit at around 25 to 30m from a base of around 100m

da.quote: This is a deep reef with three coral heads and a drop off to 100 meters.

sites.depthNote: Three coral heads at 25-30 m on a drop-off to about 100 m

highlights.text: Blacktip, grey reef and whaler sharks
Barracuda and swim-throughs on the wall

summary.text: A deep Bligh Water reef of three coral heads on the edge of a very deep drop-off, famous for shark encounters. Sharks, barracuda and big schooling fish gather around the point.

dpiAw.quote: suitable for newly qualified open water divers … 15 minute boat ride from the island resort … 22m of warm, clear water

highlights.text: Bull sharks fed behind a low reef wall
